title: Fifty
summary: Your agent is fifty and having a party in a hotel with a fountain. He wants you to give a speech about him. You don't know very much about him. A season on, the photo from the party.

ends.title: The speech
ends.text: You gave a speech at your agent's fiftieth. You found out he has a daughter and a fear of swans. He has the speech framed in his office.

ends.title: The fountain
ends.text: At your agent's fiftieth you ended up in the fountain. It's the only photo of the night anyone remembers.

beats.title: Fifty

event.title: Fifty
event.speaker: agent
setup: {agent.name}'s fiftieth, in a hotel with a fountain in the lobby. Three hundred people, most of them other agents. He pulls you aside at the bar. "You're doing a speech. Five minutes. About me."

say: "Just say something nice. And true. Mostly nice." You realise you don't know if he's married.

replies.label: Ask his mum, at table one, what to say.

ask.text: His mum tells you everything: the daughter, the paper round, the swan. Your speech makes him cry in front of three hundred agents.

wing.text: You say "he gets the job done" four times. Then you step backwards into the fountain. It gets the biggest cheer of the night.

no.text: "Fine." Another client does it, very well. He thanks you anyway, for coming.

beats.hint: Your agent has a big birthday

beats.title: The photo

event.title: The photo
event.speaker: agent
setup: A season on. You're in your agent's office for the first time in months. On the wall behind his desk, in a frame, there's something from the party.

outcomes.text: Your speech, typed up, with a photo of his mum laughing at table one. He catches you looking. "Don't," he says, and smiles.
A photo of you, up to your knees in the fountain, holding a glass in the air. "Best client I've got," he says, and means something by it.
He keeps looking past you at the frame. He's softer in negotiations than he used to be, with you.
He keeps looking past you at the photo, and laughing.

beats.hint: A season on, your agent's office
